name: Standard Room with Balcony
description: A cozy heritage-style room with a private balcony overlooking the courtyard. Simple, warm, and full of character — ideal for solo travellers or couples seeking an authentic Varanasi stay.

name: Master Room with Balcony
description: A spacious room ideal for families, with a private balcony and sweeping city views. Fitted with a king bed and a single for comfortable group stays, without sacrificing heritage charm.

name: Deluxe Room with Balcony
description: Our largest and most premium room, with two king beds and a wide balcony. Crafted for those who want the full haveli experience — generous space, period detailing, and panoramic city views.

name: Honeymoon Suite with Balcony
description: An intimate suite designed for couples, with a private balcony and heritage charm. Warm light, considered details, and the quiet of a centuries-old haveli — a beginning worth remembering.
